findings.finding: Scene data is read through the CPU object chain and compared around separately recorded lighting/ambient buffer copies. This does not identify a camera buffer consumed by a world draw.
The selected transaction is scoped to an AdaptExposure dispatch. Its own report leaves CPU scene/cache unpaired. No current-build world-geometry draw is identified by these paths.

Tracks root state and list generation/submission, copies explicit GI/exposure resources and signals a fence after the matched submission. Descriptor table handles are retained without resource resolution. The root scan compares addresses with GI/exposure ranges, not an established camera constant buffer.

next_required_evidence: A current-build concrete world-render consumer or documented callback/API, with pipeline/draw identity and an exact camera resource/offset/span relationship.
If descriptors are indirect, an established table/register/resource association rather than treating the table handle as a resource address.
Applicable resource and binding lifetime plus submission ordering; qualify the actual contract with owned adversarial producer/consumer cases before any game-facing implementation.
Independent eye-view scheduling, control and temporal-history ownership remain separate G2 requirements.
scope: Four selected immutable public files only, compared with pinned git objects after checkout line-ending normalization. Not an exhaustive engine audit or proof that a usable interface cannot exist. No mod installed, source executed, game process accessed, asset read or shader selected. M0 and its binary package remain unchanged.
